chapter: String bands, serenading and violin players
title: Harmonica and bones players, Dave Bailey, and Dawson's own harmonica
summary: Dawson tries to recall a harmonica and bones player who worked with Kid Clayton, talks about Dave Bailey and Duff Ernest, and says he could play harmonica but never did.
